# Long Relation

> AI-first product studio that designs and engineers mobile apps, games, web platforms and AI automation for companies in Saudi Arabia and the wider Gulf, covering strategy, design, launch, growth and long-term care.

## Services
- Mobile Apps: native iOS and Android, React Native and Flutter apps built for speed, retention and store visibility.
- Game Development: Unity and Unreal games and interactive worlds for PC, console, mobile and AR/VR headsets.
- AI Engineering: custom models, fine-tuned LLMs, decision engines and agent workflows tied to real business outcomes.
- Growth & Care: performance marketing, app store optimisation, support and upgrades after launch.
- Products & Platforms: commerce platforms and immersive-technology foundations.

## Engagement models
- Project-based delivery: fixed scope, budget and launch date with a dedicated project lead.
- Dedicated team: a complete strategy, design and engineering squad for larger programmes.
- Staff augmentation: vetted senior engineers, designers and product people inside your team.

## Case studies
- Manani: social dream journal (iOS/Android) with video, voice and text capture and AI dream interpretation.
- Menna: bilingual Arabic/English luxury fashion marketplace app featuring Saudi designers, with full RTL support.
- Menna Web: the Menna storefront on the web with Tabby instalment checkout and express delivery across Riyadh, Jeddah and Dammam.
